job.title: [Post] IT Program Manager – Enterprise Digital Platforms

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Commerce Consultant & Enterprise Digital Platforms Delivery
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional leader with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL, data pipelines and integration architectures. Proven delivery in techno-functional roles bridging business and IT through requirements analysis, process mapping, stakeholder management and AI-assisted delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: IT Program Manager – Enterprise Digital Platforms
cover_en.hook: I am very enthusiastic about the IT Program Manager – Enterprise Digital Platforms role at Kristi Baril, where my techno-functional expertise in enterprise e-commerce platforms can drive measurable delivery. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on experience building and delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bridge business strategy and technical execution.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Leadership
bullets.text: Worked in a techno-functional role with business stakeholders at Rockwell Automation: analysed requirements, wrote user stories and functional specifications, and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integration
bullets.text: Designed, built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and OCC REST web services, investigating and resolving integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee platforms.

bullets.label: Platform Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows while leading database query refactoring that reduced response latency.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements with product owners and business teams, mapped processes, and supported user acceptance testing and international technical teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am currently serving a notice period with a last working day of 15 December 2026 and an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my delivery experience aligns with your digital platform goals.

tailoring.why_company: I am eager to contribute to Kristi Baril's digital platforms because of your commitment to driving measurable value through enterprise-grade technology. My background leading complex SAP Commerce implementations and data integrations aligns directly with your mission to deliver seamless digital experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: Driving enterprise digital platform delivery through 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise, techno-functional analysis, and robust backend integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Kristi, I saw your opening for IT Program Manager – Enterprise Digital Platforms. With 5+ years delivering enterprise SAP Commerce solutions at Rockwell and Shell as a techno-functional leader, I would love to connect and discuss how I can support your digital initiatives.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: IT Program Manager – Enterprise Digital Platforms – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Ms Baril,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the IT Program Manager – Enterprise Digital Platforms role. With over 5 years of hands-on experience delivering enterprise SAP Commerce solutions, API integrations, and techno-functional leadership at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-positioned to drive your digital platform initiatives.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16.12.2026. I look forward to speaking with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
